description: Open benchmark implementing the pre-registered public evaluation protocol from Sharma, 'AI-Driven, Timing-Aware Power Optimization' (arXiv:2610.18890): a deterministic acceptance gate and transactional runner over OpenROAD/OpenSTA open designs, with reference entrants and a public leaderboard. Results are relative open-flow method comparisons, not signoff numbers.
title: timing-power-bench: Pre-registered public evaluation protocol for post-route power recovery
